name: Rellian Greenspyre
summary: At Denalan's lakeside retreat in Teldrassil, you carry a timberling seed to Rellian Greenspyre in Darnassus. The handoff brings news of trouble spreading through the World Tree's boughs.

sections.title: A Courier to the Capital
sections.body: Denalan has studied the plants and elemental life around Lake Al'Ameth. After gathering seeds from the local timberlings, he sends you to Darnassus with a sample for his colleague, Rellian Greenspyre. Rellian is a druid who walks the Cenarion Enclave's terraces. He had shown interest in Denalan's research and hopes to grow a timberling of his own.

sections.title: Tainted Growth
sections.body: Rellian receives the seed and brings grim news. His recent studies show that timberlings across Teldrassil are falling to a widespread, aggressive corruption. Seeds from tainted timberlings carry the blight of their parents. Rellian cannot cleanse them with his own skill, and sees Denalan's bond with living things as their best hope.

faq.answer: Rellian Greenspyre is a night elf druid who walks the pathways of Darnassus's Cenarion Enclave. He and Denalan share an interest in Teldrassil's ecology and elemental spirits.

faq.q: Why does Denalan send a timberling seed to Rellian?
faq.answer: Denalan gathered timberling seeds at Lake Al'Ameth with your help. Rellian had shared his interest in timberling life and his own ideas, so Denalan sends him a seed to try growing in the capital.

aliases: what is wrong with the timberling seed
faq.answer: Rellian finds that corruption has infected the timberlings. Their seeds carry their parents' blight, so healthy sprouts cannot grow until someone finds a cure.

faq.q: Where does this task lead next?
faq.answer: Rellian cannot cure the seeds himself. He sends you to Wellspring Lake in northern Teldrassil to cut down the most tainted timberlings and bring back their mossy tumors to burn.

faq.q: Where can Rellian Greenspyre be found?
faq.answer: Rellian walks the open pathways of the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus's northwestern corner.

faq.q: Why can't Rellian cleanse the seeds himself?
faq.answer: The corruption runs too deep for Rellian's skills. He trusts Denalan's talent for botany and growing living things, and believes his friend is the best hope for curing future generations of timberlings.

angles.text: As a druid of the Cenarion, you see how deeply an unknown sickness has reached into Teldrassil's young life. Native elemental life needs protection.
As a night elf, you know timberlings were meant to flourish with Teldrassil. Their inherited corruption bodes ill for the kaldorei's new homeland.
